items.title: S&P and Moody’s downgrade Hormel Foods following $1.05B Brakebush deal
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings and Moody’s Ratings downgraded credit ratings for Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE:HRL) following the packaged food company’s announcement of a $1.055 billion deal to acquire value-added chicken processor Brakebush Brothers Inc.

items.title: Hormel Foods Expands Further Into Proteins With $1.06 Billion Acquisition
items.summary: Hormel Foods  won’t just be about making turkey and canned lunch meat Spam anymore.  The food company announced Wednesday it will acquire Brakebush Brothers, a chicken manufacturer, for approximately $1.06 billion.  The transaction is expected to close during Hormel Foods’ fiscal first quarter in 2027.
